app_info.subtitle: Clinical trials and health AI
app_info.description: CureWise helps users explore clinical trials, review their health records and medical documents, chat with care-context AI, and run multi-model Cross Check reviews through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's CureWise profile settings and does not create or update account data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's private CureWise account workspace and does not access public internet services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists supported AI models available in CureWise and does not change any state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns the closed CureWise model catalog and does not call public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or continues a chat thread and persists a new user message in the user's CureWise chat history.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the conversation to external AI model providers to generate a response outside the private workspace boundary.
justifications.destructive_justification: Appends chat content without deleting threads, messages, or other irreversible account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists existing chat threads for the authenticated user and does not modify them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's private CureWise chat workspace and does not access public internet services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves metadata for one existing chat thread and does not modify chat state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's private CureWise chat workspace and does not access public internet services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves messages from an existing chat thread and does not add or change messages.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's private CureWise chat workspace and does not access public internet services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the user's stored clinical history summary and does not update health records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private CureWise health summary data for the authenticated user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches ClinicalTrials.gov using the user's saved search terms and does not create or change saved trial bookmarks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the public ClinicalTrials.gov registry over the internet to return matching trials.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches ClinicalTrials.gov by explicit terms and does not mutate CureWise account state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the public ClinicalTrials.gov registry over the internet to return matching trials.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves details for one ClinicalTrials.gov study by NCT ID and does not modify any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches publicly available trial details from ClinicalTrials.gov over the internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs an extraction workflow that can generate and persist clinical-trial search parameters from the user's clinical history.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates within the user's CureWise account workflow and does not publish content to public third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete bookmarks, overwrite irreversible records, or revoke access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs an eligibility analysis for a trial and can cache the resulting assessment in the user's CureWise workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores and returns eligibility results inside the user's private CureWise account rather than publishing externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete trials, documents, or account data, and cached results remain reversible by later updates.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists trials the user has already bookmarked and does not change bookmarks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's private CureWise saved-trial list and does not access public registries.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private bookmark for a clinical trial in the authenticated user's CureWise account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private saved-trial list and does not publish content publicly.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a bookmark without deleting existing data or performing irreversible account actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes an existing clinical-trial bookmark from the user's CureWise saved list.
justifications.open_world_justification: Deletes only within the user's private CureWise bookmarks and does not change public third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected bookmark from the user's saved trials until it is saved again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the user's EHR and uploaded documents with optional filters and does not modify files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private CureWise document metadata for the authenticated user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns available document filter metadata such as providers and date ranges.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private CureWise document metadata for the authenticated user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches existing document content and returns matches without changing documents.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches only the user's private CureWise document store and does not query public internet sources.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves narrative content and a short-lived download URL for an existing document.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns private patient-document content from the user's CureWise workspace only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only issues a short-lived download URL for an existing user-uploaded document and does not modify the file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Provides access only to the user's private CureWise upload and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists existing Cross Check runs for the authenticated user and does not start new ones.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private CureWise Cross Check history and does not access public internet services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves details for one existing Cross Check run and does not modify it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private CureWise Cross Check results for the authenticated user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new Cross Check comparison run and stores multi-model review results in the user's CureWise workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Persists results in the user's private CureWise account and does not publish content to public third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new comparison record without deleting existing runs or performing irreversible account actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries structured EHR portal data by domain and action and does not create or update health records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated user's private CureWise health-record store.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the user's profile and preferred model settings.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my CureWise profile, including my selected model and clinical trial search terms.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns sanitized profile fields such as model preference, language, and clinical trial search terms without internal account metadata.

test_cases.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov using explicit condition terms.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search clinical trials for metastatic breast cancer that are currently recruiting.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching ClinicalTrials.gov studies with NCT IDs, titles, and enough detail to choose a trial to inspect further.

test_cases.description: Open a specific trial and save it as a bookmark.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get details for NCT01234567 and save that trial to my CureWise bookmarks.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the trial details from ClinicalTrials.gov and confirms the trial was bookmarked in the user's private saved list.

test_cases.description: Search private medical documents for a lab term.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search my medical documents for mentions of hemoglobin A1c and summarize what you find.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching document snippets from the user's private records without modifying or deleting any documents.

test_cases.description: Start a Cross Check second-opinion review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run a Cross Check on whether immunotherapy is appropriate given my current clinical history, and show the comparison result.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a Cross Check run and returns multi-model review output stored in the user's CureWise workspace.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar or scheduling requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have on my calendar tomorrow afternoon?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar scheduling is outside CureWise supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general coding or repository tasks.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a Python script that renames files in my local Downloads folder.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because local file automation is outside CureWise supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for booking travel or shopping.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me the cheapest flight from NYC to London next weekend and book it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because travel booking is outside CureWise supported workflows.
